cues: He also heads off a misreading: it is foolish, he says, to blame human rights for the explosion of inequality.
In his blunt formula, neoliberalism, not human rights, is to blame for neoliberalism.
His closing image is the man who, having nothing but a hammer, treats everything like a nail.
Human rights are so successful that people use them for every problem.
Keep them for what they do well, and build other tools for inequality.
